input.quote: 21.1 Each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed Fees actually paid in the one month preceding the event, without exception.
input.rationale: Section 21.1 caps both Parties at one month of "Fees actually paid" and applies "without exception", which (i) sits far below the fallback 12-months'-fees basis and below the 6-month walk-away floor, and (ii) overrides the Excluded Claims regime in 21.2-21.3, so indemnities, confidentiality, data-protection/security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement all sit inside a one-month cap with no super-cap. Defined "Fees" (§1.5) also excludes taxes, expenses and implementation charges, narrowing the base further. Section 21.2 already gives a mutual exclusion of indirect and consequential damages, so the surgical fix is to correct the cap basis in 21.1, restore the Excluded Claims exception, and conform 21.3 so the payment carve-out reaches Customer's payment obligations generally rather than a subset of defined Fees.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
mappings.quote: 21.2 Except for Excluded Claims, neither Party is liable for indirect, incidental, special, exemplary, punitive, or consequential damages, or for lost profits, revenues, or goodwill, to the extent those damages are legally excludable.

mappings.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.

proposal.summary: Set the mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, restore the Excluded Claims carve-outs, and carve Customer's payment obligations generally out of capped damages.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] A one-month cap applying "without exception" is below our floor and cancels the Excluded Claims regime in 21.2-21.3, so we set the mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000 and reinstated the Excluded Claims exception, leaving confidentiality, data protection and security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement uncapped. We also conformed 21.3 so the payment carve-out covers Customer's payment obligations as a whole rather than narrowly defined "Fees"; if you prefer, we can keep the "undisputed"/"conforming Services" qualifiers and rest at our fallback.

ops.newText: Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed the greater of fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.

ops.oldText: Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees for conforming Services is not damages and is not limited by this Section.
ops.newText: Customer's obligation to pay amounts due under this Agreement is not damages and is not limited by this Section.
